maintenance_led.reason: Refrigerant sales, reclamation and on-site services mainly service and refill existing HVACR systems rather than new installations.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private HVAC contractors, distributors, and commercial and industrial facilities; government is not the main payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes mainly from refrigerant sales and reclamation; acquisitions are occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Refrigerants are largely commodity gases bought on price and availability; customers can switch suppliers easily.

notes: Maintenance-led is a judgment call: refrigerant is partly consumable, but it mainly serves existing installed HVACR systems.
